args: if [ -n "${RELAY_AGENT_BIN:-}" ]; then exec "$RELAY_AGENT_BIN" mcp; elif command -v relay-agent >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec relay-agent mcp; elif [ -x "$HOME/go/bin/relay-agent" ]; then exec "$HOME/go/bin/relay-agent" mcp; else echo "Relay executable not found: run go install ./cmd/relay-agent; for a custom install set RELAY_AGENT_BIN to its absolute path." >&2; exit 127; fi
